opportunities.name: Movie night invitation with ratings
opportunities.description: Look up a movie's IMDb rating, director and runtime, get its Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer score, then write a movie-night email to a friend for a given day.
steps: On IMDb, search for {movie_title} and open the matching title page
Note the director, runtime and IMDb rating
On Rotten Tomatoes, search for {movie_title} and open the movie page
In mail, compose a new message to {recipient_email}
Set Body to 'Hi {recipient_name}, {day} we watch {movie_title} ({director}, {runtime}): IMDb {imdb_rating}, Tomatometer {tomatometer}.'
Send the email (the recording clicked Discard instead)

instances.values: The Grand Budapest Hotel; aisha@example.com; Sunday (interleaved with npm express research)

opportunities.name: npm package stats note
opportunities.description: Collect an npm package's latest version, weekly downloads, license, GitHub stars, open issues and last release date, then save them as a note.
steps: On npmjs.com, search for {package_name} and open the exact-match package page
Note the version, weekly downloads and license
Note the stars and open issues count
Open Releases and note the date of the latest release
In notes, add a new note: '{package}: v{version}, {weekly_downloads}/week, {license}, {stars} stars, {open_issues} open issues, last release {date}'

instances.values: express (interleaved with movie email for Grand Budapest Hotel)

opportunities.name: Recipe summary note with origin
opportunities.description: Find a recipe on Allrecipes, record its rating, total time and first ingredients, look up the dish's origin on Wikipedia, and save a note for a given number of servings.
steps: Note the recipe name, star rating, total time and first 3 ingredients
On Wikipedia, search for {dish} and note its place of origin
In notes, add a new note: '{dish} for {servings}: {recipe_name} ({stars} stars, {total_time}), needs {ingredient1}, {ingredient2}, {ingredient3}. Origin: {origin}'

instances.values: pad thai; for 2 (a 'lemon tart' search was dropped first)
